title: Verify pilot feedback
description: Use only for LPM maintainers when a pilot or tester (piloto, homologação) reports an LPM problem: verify read-only, classify, register only confirmed defects in the pilot milestone, record processed reports, report to the owner; never reply to the pilot. Not for deploys (use lpm-release-product).
doneWhen: Every new report item is classified and recorded in the processed-message state file. Confirmed LPM defects exist once, in the pilot milestone, as an activity or as a comment on its duplicate. Managed-workspace demands are registered in that workspace. The owner has a report in the pilot pattern.
authorityCeiling: Process skill; read-only verification; writes activities, comments and evidence only for confirmed items; no AI calls or code searches on the reporter's workspace; never replies to the pilot.
jobs: verify the pilot's new reports and register only the confirmed defects
the tester reports the ChatGPT connector lost create_comment: check the request logs and the active OAuth grant
the pilot reported the same bug again: comment on the existing activity instead of creating a new one
verifique os relatos novos do piloto e registre só os defeitos confirmados no marco do piloto
o piloto reclamou do Advisor: classifique e transforme a falha confirmada em fixture do golden set
o piloto relatou uma demanda da plataforma do cliente: registre no workspace gerenciado, não no repositório lpm
report the processed pilot items to the owner in the pilot pattern

routing.stopText: Pilot reports are verified by LPM maintainers. Forward the report to them.

notFor.when: fixing, deploying or announcing the fix of a registered pilot defect
writing the code of the fix for a registered activity
planning more work in the managed workspace than one registered demand
a customer request that arrives by WhatsApp or an intake protocol, not from a pilot
